question: The bakery received 180 boxes and 38 more. Each box holds 2 trays, and each tray holds 5 pies, all set on the shelf. It sold 1505 pies on Saturday and 456 on Sunday, then baked 42 more for the shelf. How many pies are on the shelf?

Rae sowed 107 pepper seeds, and 54 failed to sprout. She doubled her plants by taking cuttings. Each plant produced 6 peppers for her harvest basket, and she bought 71 peppers at the market to add to the basket. How many peppers are in the basket?

In the morning Nia's shop opened with 96 boxes of 8 candles and took delivery of 47 more, which she counted twice. In the afternoon she sold 83 candles and then 79. In the evening she sold 59. Nia sold more candles than Theo. How many candles does Nia have?

In the morning the cidery had 107 barrels of 9 gallons and added 49 gallons, recorded in quarts at 4 quarts to a gallon. In the afternoon 2294 quarts were sold. In the evening each remaining quart was priced at 8 dollars, and the manager projected the same evening takings for each of 7 days. How many dollars is the projection?

In the morning the club had 126 tickets and sold 65. In the afternoon each remaining ticket came with 5 vouchers, and 17 vouchers were added. In the evening 127 vouchers were redeemed. How many vouchers are left?

In the morning the rigger had 69 fathoms of rope, measured in feet at 6 feet to a fathom, and each foot needs 3 clips. In the afternoon half of the clips were used and 369 were lost. In the evening each remaining clip was priced at 6 cents on the invoice. How many cents is the invoice?

The timekeeper logs the race in minutes and never converts to hours. The first leg took 67 minutes, the second 73 minutes, the third 64 minutes, the fourth 10 minutes, and the final sprint 8 minutes. How many minutes did the race take?

Ola had 66 beads, used 58, and bought 47 more, which she counted twice. She gave 37 to Ike, who now has more beads than Ola. Each of her remaining beads is worth 8 points. How many points does Ola have?

Nadia has been playing the piano for a dozen years, and she plans her practice carefully. Her old daily routine took 73 minutes, a little over an hour. She cut 14 minutes of scales and 17 minutes of sight-reading, but she added a 44-minute new piece, a 19-minute warm-up, and a 69-minute recital run-through. She then followed this new routine exactly on each of 6 days. How many minutes did Nadia practise over those 6 days in total?

Amir collects arcade tokens. On each of 3 visits he won 217 tokens. He lost 44 tokens through a hole in his bag, and then his cousin handed him 69 tokens. The arcade is open 12 hours a day. At the prize counter every token is redeemed for 6 tickets, and Amir redeems all of his tokens. How many tickets does Amir get?

The history shelf in the town library held 194 books at the start of the week. On Monday 151 of them were lent out to a school for a project. On Tuesday the librarian removed 7 damaged books from the shelf. On Wednesday 11 books were donated to a hospital library, and on Thursday 10 more were borrowed by readers. How many books were left on the history shelf?

Rosa had 122 stamps in her collection, and at a market she found 7 more. The market charged 3 dollars for entry. Rosa then traded 123 of her stamps to a dealer, who replaced each stamp she still had with 2 rare stamps. Her cousin Ben, who had only 15 stamps, far fewer than Rosa started with, gave her all 15 of his. Finally Rosa bought 40 stamps at a fair. How many stamps does Rosa have now?

Theo keeps a coin jar that held 197 cents, almost two dollars. He dropped in 22 cents he found on the pavement. Then he took out 173 cents to buy a snack. Later in the week he added 78 cents, and after that another 54 cents. How many cents are in the jar now?

A city bus left the depot with 36 passengers on board. At the first stop 3 people got on. At the second stop 23 people got off, and at the third stop 12 more got off. The route is 14 kilometres long. At the railway station 78 people got on, and at the last stop before the centre 17 more boarded. How many passengers were on the bus then?

A farm's sprinkler system runs in cycles of 180 seconds, which is three minutes each. Every zone gets 4 cycles, and there are 5 zones in each field. The farm has 9 fields, and the whole system runs 2 sessions a day. If it runs like this for 7 days, how many seconds of sprinkling does the farm carry out in total?

A bakery had 107 cookies on its cooling racks. 7 of them were broken and thrown away. The baker sold half of the remaining cookies in the morning rush. She then baked a second batch so that she had twice as many cookies as were left. Just before closing a neighbour brought over 29 cookies for the bakery to sell. How many cookies does the bakery have now?

In the morning Kofi loaded 3 top-up cards onto his phone, and each card gave him 114 minutes of talk time. The company added a bonus of 17 minutes. In the afternoon he made a call that lasted 230 minutes, nearly four hours. In the evening he spoke to his sister Ama, who uses far more minutes each day than Kofi does, for 46 minutes. How many minutes of talk time did Kofi have left after that?

Priya earns 35 dollars for every hour she tutors, but 8 dollars of each hour's pay is held back for tax. Each of her shifts lasts 2 hours. She works 9 shifts every week. If she keeps this up for 6 weeks, how many dollars does Priya take home?

In the morning a food truck prepared a batch of filling that gave 69 servings, and an extra pot added 22 servings to the batch. Every batch made that day was exactly this size. During the afternoon the crew cooked 4 batches. In the evening they found 27 more servings in a cooler, but they gave 60 servings to the staff for dinner. How many servings did the truck have at the end of the evening?

Dana had 211 beads for her jewellery stall. She lent 52 beads to Omar, who owns far fewer beads than Dana. A week later Omar returned all 52 beads. Dana then bought 30 more beads. She sells every bead for 8 cents. If she sells all of her beads, how many cents will Dana receive?

A drama club raised money by selling tickets for its show. It sold 17 tickets on Monday, 23 on Tuesday, and 78 on Wednesday. The hall seats 200 people. Every ticket was sold for 9 dollars. A parent also gave the club a 22-dollar donation. How many dollars did the club raise altogether?

Ruth's daily commute used to take 72 minutes, a little over an hour. A new bus route saved her 24 minutes, and moving to a flat closer to work saved another 24 minutes. A road detour then added 17 minutes to the trip. Finally a new express lane cut 27 minutes off. Ruth commutes 6 days every week. How many minutes does Ruth now spend commuting in a week?

A wholesaler sells snack bars for 20 cents each. There are 6 bars in a pack, 3 packs in a box, and 5 boxes in a crate, so one crate of bars costs eighteen dollars before delivery. The wholesaler adds 17 cents to the price of each crate for delivery. A shop orders 7 crates. How many cents does the shop pay?

Lucas collected 32 seashells on the beach in the morning and found 39 more after lunch. His sister Ines, who had gathered more shells than Lucas that day, gave him 75 of hers. In the beach contest every shell is worth 3 points. Lucas lost 9 points for shells that were cracked, and he earned a 51-point bonus for the rarest shell. How many points did Lucas score?

In the morning a delivery driver has 65 stops on his list, but 36 of them are cancelled. Each stop that remains takes 4 minutes. In the afternoon he spends 32 minutes loading and 56 minutes on fuel and paperwork, so his whole working day is a little under three and a half hours. In the evening the manager works out that 3 drivers each did exactly the same amount of work today, and that the same happened on each of 3 days. How many minutes of work is that altogether?
